# First baseline run — gold v1, hashing embedder, no reranker

**Environment limits of this run.** It used the deterministic `hashing` embedder (feature
hashing, *not* a semantic model), and no `reranker-service` was reachable, so the
`hybrid-rerank` and `hybrid-symbol-e5` configurations were not run. The index was built from the
working tree of branch `claude/ahawr-context-retrieval-layer-uq2ffv` before it was committed.

**Reading.**

* The harness works end to end on identical tasks and an identical snapshot for every
  configuration.
* With a non-semantic embedder, the vector channel adds little over BM25 at chunk level.
  `hybrid-symbol` matches the lexical baseline on MRR and Recall@10, and improves file-level
  Recall@5 (+0.029) and file MRR (+0.029). It costs ~3 ms mean and ~14 ms p95 latency.
* The retry-cache decisions were correct on every variant (accuracy 1.0, no false reuse).
  Reformatted and reworded Reviewer feedback reused the retrieval; feedback naming a new file
  or a different problem triggered re-retrieval.
* **Decision (per EVALUATION.md):** hashing-hybrid alone does not beat BM25, so it does not
  justify itself yet. Next, run `hybrid-symbol-e5` (a real embedding endpoint) and
  `hybrid-rerank` (reranker-service) on this dataset, extend the gold set with real AHAWR
  missions and a silver set, and only then pick the default configuration for
  `retrieval_label`.
